item: PF08 built: the collection-speed knob says kbit/s
key_paths: src/static/app-sources.js; src/static/index.html; src/static/app-core.js; src/static/locales/*.json; CLAUDE.md; tests/test_rate_knob_units.py
summary: The top-bar knob's hover, its two toasts and the index.html comment said 500 KiB/s while collect_target_kbps is kilobits per second; they now say 500 kbit/s, re-keyed in all 12 locales (never a second key beside the old one), and CLAUDE.md invariant #4 is amended. The stored setting and the governor are unchanged. Walked in Chromium: the hover and both toasts follow the language drop-down in en, fr, ar, ru, bn. test_rate_knob_units.py pins that no KiB/s survives on the knob and that the governor constant is unchanged.
